sglang-release.migrationNotes:
## Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes

* **SGLang requires Python 3.11 or newer.** On Python 3.10, `pip install sglang` does not fail; it resolves to the last release that supported 3.10. Move to Python 3.11+ (for example off the Ubuntu 22.04 system Python) to get this and later releases: [#43021](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43021)
* **`--enable-dp-attention` is deprecated; use `--attn-dp-size N`.** `--dp-size` now counts model replicas only. The old `--dp-size N --enable-dp-attention` still resolves to `--attn-dp-size N` with a warning; combining replicas with attention DP, or passing both spellings, is rejected at startup: [#41818](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41818). Under DeepSeek context parallelism, `--dp-size N` still means attention DP but now warns and will be rejected after 2026-12-31: [#42348](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42348)
* **`--disaggregation-decode-host-receive-threshold` flips its encoding.** `1` (the new default) disables host receive and `0` now means always receive on host. Configurations that passed `0` to disable it must pass `1`: [#43407](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43407)
* **`ChunkCache` is removed.** With `--disable-radix-cache`, full-attention, hybrid-SWA and Mamba models run `UnifiedRadixCache` in disabled mode and pure-SWA models run `PureSWARadixCache` ([#43198](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43198), [#43199](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43199), [#43200](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43200), [#42354](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42354), [#43201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43201)). Streaming sessions now start only on `UnifiedRadixCache`; pure-SWA, FlexKV and plugin tree caches fail at startup with a "not verified" error ([#42295](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42295)), and beam search rejects Mamba models with `--disable-radix-cache` too ([#42354](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42354))
* **The `tc_piecewise` prefill CUDA graph backend is removed.** Passing `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill tc_piecewise` or a `tc_compiler` setting now raises an error; CUDA keeps `breakable` as the default prefill graph backend, and other platforms default to no prefill graph: [#42287](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42287)
* **Renamed and retired environment variables.** `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DCP_DECODE_BACKEND` becomes `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND` and its default changes from `gluon` to `asm` ([#34537](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34537)); `SGLANG_OPT_SWA_RELEASE_LEAF_LOCK_AFTER_WINDOW` becomes `SGLANG_OPT_RELEASE_PREFILL_SWA` ([#42657](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42657)); the old names keep working with a deprecation warning. `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING` and `SGLANG_DSPARK_OPT_FUSED_GREEDY_MARKOV` are deprecated and no longer do anything ([#43622](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43622), [#43668](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43668)), and `SGLANG_TRITON_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_ALIGN_SIZE` is deprecated: [#43444](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43444)
* **OpenAI chat responses changed in three small ways.** `tool_choice: "none"` no longer shows tool schemas to DeepSeek models ([#43006](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43006)), an absent `tool_calls` field is omitted instead of returned as `null` ([#43027](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43027)), and a stream keeps one `created` timestamp for its whole lifetime: [#43026](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43026)
* **`--enable-layernorm-sp` is rejected with pipeline parallelism.** It failed on the first prefill before: [#43458](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43458)
* **For model and plugin authors:** `ModelRunner.tp_group` is removed; read `get_parallel().tp_group` in the scope the code runs in ([#41817](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41817)). Unread placement attributes such as `model.tp_size` are gone; read `get_parallel()` ([#41812](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41812)). A model that declares stage boundaries and runs under pipeline parallelism must pass its shared stage declaration (`stage_facts`) to `make_layers` / `make_pp_layers`: [#43460](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43460)

gguf-pr.title: Reject truncated GGUF tensor data in split and export tools
gguf-pr.body:
## Overview

This change addresses incorrect tensor data handling when a GGUF file is truncated or its tensor data extends beyond the end of the file.

In gguf-split, the requested tensor data could be read incompletely without the short read being detected. Since the read buffer is reused, the remaining bytes could contain data from a previous tensor, resulting in corrupted output without the expected error.

The changes add bounds validation for tensor data in gguf-split and export-lora, along with checks to detect incomplete reads. A regression test creates a small GGUF file containing two tensors, truncates the file before the second tensor's data, and verifies that the tool rejects the input. It also checks that splitting the valid file preserves the expected tensor data.


## Additional information

NA

## Requirements

<!-- IMPORTANT: Please do NOT delete this section, otherwise your PR may be rejected -->

- I have read and agree with the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- AI usage disclosure:YES
AI assistance covered investigating the truncated-GGUF issue, analyzing the cause of the unchecked reads, proposing the bounds-check implementation, and developing the regression test.
I applied the patch, built the affected tools, ran the regression tests, reviewed the Git diff, and submitted the changes.
